description: 单级齿轮减速器装配体（壳体+齿轮+轴）
description_en: A single-stage gear reducer assembly with housing, gears and shafts
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# === 全局参数 ===
# 齿轮参数
module = 3
z1 = 18           # 小齿轮齿数
z2 = 54           # 大齿轮齿数
face_width = 25   # 齿宽 (mm)

# 轴参数
shaft1_d = 20     # 输入轴直径 (mm)
shaft2_d = 30     # 输出轴直径 (mm)
shaft_len = 80    # 轴露出长度 (mm)

# 齿轮分度圆
d1 = module * z1
d2 = module * z2
center_dist = (d1 + d2) / 2   # 中心距

# 壳体参数
housing_margin = 30
housing_w = center_dist + d2 / 2 + housing_margin * 2
housing_d = max(d2, 80) + housing_margin * 2
housing_h = face_width + 40
wall_t = 6


def make_housing():
    """减速器壳体"""
    body = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .box(housing_w, housing_d, housing_h)
        .edges("|Z").fillet(5)
        .faces(">Z").shell(-wall_t)
    )
    # 输入轴孔
    body = (
        body.faces("<X").workplane()
        .center(0, 0)
        .hole(shaft1_d + 10)
    )
    # 输出轴孔
    body = (
        body.faces(">X").workplane()
        .center(0, -center_dist / 2)
        .hole(shaft2_d + 10)
    )
    return body


def make_gear(tip_d, bore_d, width):
    """简化齿轮 (圆柱近似)"""
    return (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(tip_d / 2)
        .extrude(width)
        .faces(">Z").workplane()
        .hole(bore_d)
        .faces(">Z").chamfer(1)
        .faces("<Z").chamfer(1)
    )


def make_shaft(diameter, length):
    """轴"""
    return (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(diameter / 2)
        .extrude(length)
    )


# === 创建零件 ===
tip1 = d1 + 2 * module
tip2 = d2 + 2 * module

housing = make_housing()
gear1 = make_gear(tip1, shaft1_d, face_width)
gear2 = make_gear(tip2, shaft2_d, face_width)
input_shaft = make_shaft(shaft1_d, face_width + shaft_len)
output_shaft = make_shaft(shaft2_d, face_width + shaft_len)

# === 装配 ===
assy = cq.Assembly()

# 壳体
assy.add(housing, name="housing", color=cq.Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 0.5))

# 齿轮和轴的 Z 位置: 壳体中心
gear_z = -face_width / 2

# 输入轴 + 小齿轮 (壳体左侧中心)
input_x = -housing_w / 4
assy.add(input_shaft, name="input_shaft",
         loc=cq.Location((input_x, 0, gear_z)),
         color=cq.Color("silver"))
assy.add(gear1, name="pinion",
         loc=cq.Location((input_x, 0, gear_z)),
         color=cq.Color("steelblue"))

# 输出轴 + 大齿轮 (偏移中心距)
output_x = input_x + center_dist
assy.add(output_shaft, name="output_shaft",
         loc=cq.Location((output_x, 0, gear_z)),
         color=cq.Color("silver"))
assy.add(gear2, name="gear",
         loc=cq.Location((output_x, 0, gear_z)),
         color=cq.Color("orange"))

result = assy
show_object(result)
